about.eventbrite: the Eventbrite ticketing and event listing platform
about.meetup: the Meetup app for finding and running interest groups
about.fable: Fable Social (fable.social), a campus events app and newsletter for Toronto Metropolitan University and other Canadian students; not the Fable book club app
about.what2do_utm: What2Do (what2docampus.com), a club and event discovery site for University of Toronto Mississauga students, linked from the UTM students' union
about.what2do_jhu: What2Do, a student-built campus events feed app from Johns Hopkins University (Instagram @joinwhat2do)
about.clubhive: ClubHive (clubhive.ca), a Canadian app where university clubs post their events to one calendar
about.huddle: Huddle Social, a student events app that started at Purdue and spread to other US colleges
about.unico: UniCo, an events app for Montreal university students (McGill, Concordia, UdeM)
about.fayble: Fayble, an event hosting app by Brown University students
about.campusgroups: CampusGroups (campusgroups.com), the student clubs and events platform many universities run, often under a school-branded name
about.anthology_engage: Anthology Engage, formerly Campus Labs Engage, the clubs and events portal universities run under names like BoilerLink, ULife or MinerLink
about.corq: Corq, the Campus Labs / Anthology Engage mobile app for campus events
about.modern_campus_involve: Modern Campus Involve, formerly Presence, a student involvement and events platform universities run
about.luma: Luma (lu.ma), the event pages and invites app many student clubs use
about.partiful: Partiful, the party invite and RSVP app popular with college students
about.posh: Posh (posh.vip), the event ticketing and discovery app for college nightlife and parties

lanes.app_stores: App Store and Google Play reviews of the {{competitor_name}} app; open its listing pages and read the reviews
lanes.review_sites: review sites such as Trustpilot, Google reviews, G2 and Capterra
lanes.forums: student, organizer and community forums, blogs, Quora, Hacker News, student newspapers and news comments; anywhere except X, app stores and review sites (Reddit cannot be opened from here, so skip it)
